hypotheses.L0_layouts_retain_exact_behavior: At least three families retain at least two held-out pairs whose two endpoints both produce the exact correct top-1 token in at least one altered-distance layout.
hypotheses.L1_native_edited_edges_survive_layout_ch: Native edited-position edges reach program-output fidelity at least 0.80 in at least three families on their shortest operational altered layout.
hypotheses.L2_original_frozen_routes_transfer_acros: Original discovery-mean routes applied to altered-layout values reach output fidelity at least 0.70 in at least three families on their shortest operational altered layout.
hypotheses.L3_two_token_distance_shift_transfers: At least two families retain exact competence and frozen-route fidelity at least 0.70 under the two-token insertion.
hypotheses.L4_route_coefficients_are_layout_stable: Mean cosine between original discovery routes and altered-layout held-out mean routes is at least 0.90 over operational family-layout cells.
